title: Optimal entry and exit for variance swaps: closed-form rules for the perpetual contract
abstract: arXiv:2609.19102v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Variance swaps are a convenient instrument for trading vega and convexity, and a listed contract now trades on Cboe. We ask when a trader should put such a position on and when she should take it off, and for a perpetual, continuously settled contract we answer both in closed form: each threshold is the unique root of a smooth-pasting equation in confluent hypergeometric functions.   Under the pricing measure the question has no content, the mark-to-market being a martingale. Under the physical measure with a variance risk premium it becomes meaningful, and then reduces: the accrued variance separates exactly, the maturity, strike and costs are absorbed into a single forcing term whose sign fixes the geometry of the exercise region, and what is left on the perpetual is an affine reward on a CIR process, which the optimal-stopping literature already solves.   Entering the position and exiting it are not mirror images. An exit rule follows

translated_title: 方差互换的最优进场与出场：永续合约的闭式规则
translated_abstract: 方差互换是交易vega与凸性的便捷工具，目前Cboe已有此类上市合约。我们探讨交易者应何时建立此类头寸、何时将其了结，并针对永续、连续结算的合约以闭式形式回答了这两个问题：每个阈值都是含合流超几何函数的平滑粘贴方程的唯一根。在定价测度下，由于盯市价值是鞅，该问题并无实质内容；而在带有方差风险溢价的真实测度下，该问题变得有意义，并可被简化：累计方差可被精确分离，到期日、执行价与成本被吸收为一个单一强迫项，其符号决定了行权区域的几何结构，永续合约上剩下的只是CIR过程上的一个仿射报酬问题，而这在最优停止文献中已有解答。建立头寸与退出头寸并非互为镜像。退出规则遵循……（摘要至此中断）
tldr: 该论文针对永续方差互换合约，首次给出交易者最优进场与出场时机的闭式规则——每个阈值均为含合流超几何函数的平滑粘贴方程的唯一根，并揭示建立头寸与退出头寸的策略并非镜像对称。
en_tdlr: The paper derives the first closed-form optimal entry and exit rules for perpetual variance swaps, showing that each threshold is the unique root of a smooth-pasting equation in confluent hypergeometric functions and that entering and exiting the position are not mirror images.
